label: Match Restore
description: Saves the state of a running match (players with their position, velocity and view direction, items, timers and the match clock) and puts it back later, or restores a moment from a recorded .qlmatch pack, with the admin command !restore. Needs the minqlxtended runtime and the restore/ folder, which downloads with it.

commands.name: restore
commands.usage: export | test [name] | quiet | loud | clear | time | map | player | item | apply | verify | show | players [slot:cid...] | match list [filter] [page] | match <N> <mm:ss>
commands.description: export writes the current state as checkpoint JSON to the server log. clear, time, map, player and item build a checkpoint line by line; show and verify check it; apply restores it. match list and match <N> <mm:ss> restore a moment from a .qlmatch pack on this server. test [name] loads a checkpoint file from a data/checkpoints/ folder next to the plugin; none ship with this repository.

commands.name: restorecheckpoint
commands.usage: export | test [name] | quiet | loud | clear | time | map | player | item | apply | verify | show | players [slot:cid...] | match list [filter] [page] | match <N> <mm:ss>

cvars.label: Native Clock
cvars.description: Use the engine's own match clock instead of the plugin's tracked clock.

cvars.label: Unfreeze Delay (s)
cvars.description: Seconds after an unpause before the match clock runs again, to cover the 3-2-1 unfreeze countdown.
